test(keepalive-r2 A r6, Codex N4 a/b): the test root under the one trusted anchor; every child takes it from the guard

Codex codex_keepalive_r2_spike_r5.md N4.
a) test_tmp.root(): REMOTE60_TEST_TMP must be ONE plain folder directly under D:/remote/remote/.claude/test-tmp
   (the anchor: it must exist, be no link, and resolve to itself); checked before anything is made (one mkdir,
   inside the anchor only) and again on the real path after. A path merely shaped like .claude/test-tmp/<name>
   elsewhere, or a link, is refused.
b) recovery_fault, relay_wire, account_admin, device_credential take their folder from testTmp.scratchDir()
   (no raw variable, no worktree fallback; alone without the variable they stop before writing) and remove it
   through testTmp.remove().
Test code only.
